scripts.screenshots: docker run --rm -v /tmp/pw-screenshots:/tmp/screenshots -v $(pwd)/dist:/dist:ro -v $(pwd)/scripts:/scripts:ro -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.52.0-noble bash -c 'npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm i playwright@1.52.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && cp /scripts/playwright-screenshots.js . && node playwright-screenshots.js'
scripts.screenshots:live: docker run --rm --network host -v /tmp/pw-screenshots:/tmp/screenshots -v $(pwd)/scripts:/scripts:ro -w /work -e TARGET_URL=https://apps.geoglows.org/ mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.52.0-noble bash -c 'npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm i playwright@1.52.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && cp /scripts/playwright-screenshots.js . && node playwright-screenshots.js'
